_comment: Recorder-Solana CXP-SOL-1; Chain-Support-Matrix.md §1.1: a source whose terms do not permit republishing derived data is unusable, and an unresolved answer is treated as forbidden.

produce-sol-snapshot.mjs refuses to publish a tree read from any source not listed here. Capture is not gated: a capture may read from a source while its terms are being resolved, and nothing it read is published until they are.
A paid provider is added only with the terms that permit republication, named in its basis.

sources.https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com: keyless public RPC run by the Solana Foundation; no account and no agreement; it serves the chain's own public ledger
sources.https://solana-rpc.publicnode.com: keyless public RPC run by publicnode; no account and no agreement; it serves the chain's own public ledger
